integrity: The proof and accompanying numerical checks were performed in the same review process; no independent audit or validation has occurred. The numerical checker is supporting evidence and not a substitute for a proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact mathematical results concern ideal center-passing Haar-distributed planes in three-dimensional ellipsoids; finite-sample reconstruction and stable noisy inversion are not established. The forward distribution belongs to classical orthogonal compression theory; originality is limited to the sharp inverse one-threshold criterion and identifiability boundary. Historical priority of the inverse formulation is not independently certified.
title: One-threshold reconstruction and the identifiability boundary for random ellipsoid sections
